name: AR-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with R+23 partisan lean
Incumbent Rick Crawford well-funded with $1.0M cash on hand
Democrat Terri Green raised only $65K with $12K on hand
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~97%
model.rationale: Crawford holds a heavily Republican northeast Arkansas seat with a large financial advantage, while Green's fundraising is negligible and no polls or expert ratings suggest competitiveness. Markets price a Republican win near certainty, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: A major late-breaking scandal or unexpected outside spending surge against Crawford would be the only plausible path to competitiveness.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rick Crawford seeks another term in this deeply Republican northeast Arkansas district, where the partisan lean favors Republicans by more than twenty points. He enters the general election with over a million dollars on hand after easily securing renomination. Democrat Terri Green has raised only about $65,000 and has minimal cash available, leaving her with little capacity to communicate with voters. A Libertarian candidate also appears on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings exist for the race, but prediction markets give Crawford roughly a 97% chance of winning. The combination of the district's lean, Crawford's incumbency and financial dominance, and his opponent's limited resources points to a safe Republican hold with little realistic prospect of an upset.
